incremental.scope: Matched finite normal requests with fixed bodies/max budgets and exact actual output hashes, finish reasons and three logical usage counts, including natural EOS. No unequal-work speedup comparison. Silence is SSE arrival gap, not token TBT. prompt_ms includes engine prompt stage. Whole-case rate includes admission and final drain. No automatic deployment/performance pass.

visible_phase_coverage.scope: Each of four finite resident streams has visible output before and after every measured phase. Delayed HTTP/terminal completion alone does not qualify. Existing silence metrics are unchanged.

reader_source_proof.scope: Only pump rows committed after reader start and before observed reader done. Final drain and ambiguous boundary pumps excluded; rows count native emitted BT output tokens (including termination), not API visible-content tokens or only accepted draft tokens.

visible_phase_coverage.scope: Each of four finite resident streams has visible output before and after every measured phase. Delayed HTTP/terminal completion alone does not qualify. Existing silence metrics are unchanged.

reader_source_proof.scope: Only pump rows committed after reader start and before observed reader done. Final drain and ambiguous boundary pumps excluded; rows count native emitted BT output tokens (including termination), not API visible-content tokens or only accepted draft tokens.

limits: One complete synthetic conversation pair, ON then OFF, with four unrelated finite residents and three true user/assistant continuations. Exact actual output/message/request/cache equality; natural EOS is actual matched work.

Post-seed throughput includes resident admission, actual conversation tokenizer preflight, injection, waiting intervals, recovery and final drain. It is not pure decode throughput. Whole-case throughput also includes cold seed.

Tail output stalls shrink and finite-cohort throughput improves, while ordinary chunk p95 and incremental-request TTFT become slower. Remaining ~1.8s stalls and sampled GPU activity show the requested full utilization is not achieved.
SSE chunks can contain multiple tokens; no token TBT is inferred. Raw p95 counts full interchunk gaps ending inside phase. Clipped gaps describe phase overlap.

NVML is nominal500ms rolling activity sampling, actual mixed sampling gap up to0.714s. Per-card arithmetic means and p10 do not measure achieved FLOPS or bandwidth. Requested2000MHz is not the observed SM clock.

Native read/source evidence revalidated from frozen runner-retained numeric records; no raw engine log is included in this local copied pair. Native BT strict progress can include termination and is not API throughput.
